title: Quietly Quenched Ethiopian Chicken Doro Wot
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish with a twist, featuring chicken and spices wrapped in ti leaves, served with a side of vanilla custard.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
Let the mixture marinate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Meanwhile, prepare the ti leaves by washing and drying them thoroughly.
To assemble the dish, place a small amount of the chicken mixture onto the center of a ti leaf, then shape into a nigiri-like form.
Fold the ti leaf over the filling to form a tight package, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat, then add the wrapped chicken packages and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side.
Serve the chicken packages with a side of vanilla custard, and garnish with additional ti leaves if desired.
To make the vanilla custard, combine 1 cup of coconut milk, 1/2 cup of maple syrup, and 1/4 teaspoon of salt in a saucepan, then cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove the custard from the heat and stir in 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla extract, then let cool to room temperature.
